actions.task_instruction: Place the red block at the center of the stack zone.
Stack the green block on top of the red block.
Stack the blue block on top of the green block.
Pick up the red block from the top of the stack and place it on the table.
Pick up the red block from the table and place it at the center of the stack zone.
Pick up the green block and stack it on top of the red block.
Pick up the blue block and stack it on top of the green block.

resolved_task.confirmed_intent: Stack the red, green, and blue blocks with red at the bottom, green in the middle, and blue on top.

episodes.summary: The user requested a block stack in red-green-blue order from bottom to top, but the execution resulted in an inverted stack (blue-green-red).
episodes.user_request: Stack the blocks in red, green, blue order from bottom to top.
episodes.user_visible_result: The blocks were stacked in the wrong order. The red block is on top instead of at the bottom.

discrepancies: The stack order is inverted: blue is at the bottom, green is in the middle, and red is at the top, which contradicts the requirement of red at the bottom and blue on top.

failure.description: The stack order is incorrect. The requirement was red (bottom), green (middle), blue (top), but the result is blue (bottom), green (middle), red (top).

evaluation-participant.text: The user attempted to stack red, green, and blue blocks in that specific order from bottom to top, but the execution resulted in an inverted stack.
